about: The three-way merge a device runs when a preset (docs/app-slots.md §17.3) is applied: base = the values the preset set last time (kept by the device), current = the device's values now ("" or absent: never chosen), next = the new version's settings. A key changes only where the device still has the old preset's value, or never had one; the customer's own choices stay. set = what is written (only where it differs from current), base_after = what the device keeps for the next version. Packages: added when new to the preset, never removed, and one the customer removed is not brought back. The firmware's test (test_host/preset_test.cpp) runs every case.

settings.name: first apply on a new unit: every key
v2 changes a key the customer never touched
v3 still sees the customer's change (the base stays the preset's)
a key new in v2 that was never chosen
a key new in v2 that the customer had chosen
a key v2 no longer sets stays as it is
the customer cleared a key (back to the device's default): kept
v2 says what the device has: nothing written
the customer already picked what v2 now says: the base follows
the slots merge like any key: the person chose an assistant
a key absent from current counts as never chosen

packages.name: first apply: what is not installed yet is wanted
one the customer removed is not brought back
a package v2 drops is never removed
